layout_provenance_caveat: Packet physical-layout executable was built against the cached vendor target header. PERF reports bpf_array fields in that header differ from boot-matched ELF BTF. Earlier XDP9/TC8 kernel checks cover their exercised fields only; do not infer all emitted packet fields match authoritative BTF. Follow-up should use boot-matched BTF facts rather than treating this header as authoritative.
